children: Faraday Future entered into a Consulting Services Agreement with AIBOT to support FCC compliance for its robotics division. The engagement covers engineering, manufacturing and test support, product and supply chain assessment, and monitoring of regulatory developments for $25,000 per month over an initial 12-month term. The company may terminate the agreement at any time upon notice. The arrangement was reviewed and approved by the Board’s Audit Committee under the related-party transaction policy.
: Support FCC compliance and regulatory strategy for robotics products
